description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-exports/payroll/employers (#8041, ADR 0319)
at a Träger with two schools, one of them employed by a Gemeinde: the Träger's
schools, the binding of the Träger transaction, its release, which body
employs at each school (the bodies and the settings responsibility.* in one
batch read) and the stored payroll values in one statement. Flat in the
number of schools and employers.
